cohort: A 34-year-old woman with undiagnosed Behcet's disease who underwent a cesarean section.
finding: The diagnosis of post-surgical pyoderma gangrenosum can be challenging and should be considered in patients with unexplained skin dehiscence and negative microbial culture, particularly in those with Behcet's disease.
mod_finding: Post-surgical pyoderma gangrenosum occurred after a cesarean section.
